{{Quote|I'm Commander Byten, Imperial Non-human Relations. My men were extracting a key political prisoner from the lower cells. Something went wrong.|Byten|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Byten''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in [[Imperial Non-human Relations]], a division of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] operating during the [[Galactic War]] between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[invasion of Belsavis]], Byten dispatched a unit to retrieve [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Shange]], a [[Cathar (location)/Legends|Cathar]] who had opposed his [[Species/Legends|species]]' joining the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and was imprisoned on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. Though Byten's unit was wiped out, he was able to recruit other Imperials in the area to free Shange, allowing the Empire to spin Shange's story in an attempt to break the Cathar loyalty to the Republic.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Commander Byten appears in a cutscene on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where provides Imperial players with the mission "Once and Future."<ref name="TOR" />
